prompt: Using the provided reference image, redraw it as a polished exaggerated editorial caricature while preserving the original Financial Times-style composition and all key elements. Keep the same seated-at-keyboard pose, the hands reaching toward the keyboard, the white grid-paper background, the red/pink dotted side shapes, the blue dotted rounded rectangle in the upper right, and the same lower-left headline text: Yang Zhilin, the rock star founder behind China’s Moonshot AI. Transform the portrait into a glossy, high-detail digital caricature with an oversized head, fuller cheeks, slightly comical smile, enlarged glasses, stylized black hair, painterly skin texture, and a more satirical magazine-illustration look. Keep the crop tight and vertical, with the face much larger in frame than the reference and the text overlay still readable in large white serif type across the lower third. Maintain the keyboard along the bottom edge and do not add any new objects, logos, watermarks, or extra text.

promptZh: 使用提供的参考图像，将其重绘为精致且夸张的社论漫画，同时保留原始的《金融时报》（Financial Times）风格构图及所有关键元素。保持相同的坐姿（手放在键盘上）、白色网格纸背景、红色/粉色点状侧边形状、右上角的蓝色点状圆角矩形，以及左下角相同的标题文本：杨植麟，中国 Moonshot AI 背后的摇滚明星创始人。将肖像转换为光泽感强、细节丰富的数字漫画，特征包括超大的头部、更饱满的脸颊、略带滑稽的微笑、放大的眼镜、风格化的黑发、绘画感的皮肤纹理，以及更具讽刺意味的杂志插图风格。保持紧凑的垂直裁剪，使面部在画面中的占比远大于参考图，同时确保下方的白色衬线大字体标题文本依然清晰可读。保留底部的键盘，不要添加任何新的物体、Logo、水印或额外文本。
